name: DUBOISIA MYOPOROIDES
key_symptoms: Impossible to stand with eyes shut, tendency to fall backwards.
Larynx dry, voice hoarse, phonation difficult. Dry cough with oppressed breathing.
Loss of power in limbs, staggers; feels as if he stepped on empty space. Trembling, numbness and weakness.
